name: Toothed Whales
description: Toothed whales are the predatory Cetaceans: the dolphins, porpoises and sperm whales, which hunt with teeth and echolocation rather than filtering the sea like the baleen whales.$(br2)The largest dolphins, the orca and its relatives, live in close family groups called pods that hunt together, and pass their hunting techniques from one generation to the next.$(br2)They are found in every ocean, from the polar ice to the tropics.
